description:
pkix-ct/src/verify.rs:872-940 has build_signed_input_x509_entry (28 lines) and build_signed_input_precert_entry (25 lines). pkix-ct/src/verify.rs:784-835 has build_merkle_tree_leaf_x509_entry (23 lines) and build_merkle_tree_leaf_precert_entry (25 lines). All four functions share:
- u8 version_v1
- u8 fixed_type_byte (SIG_TYPE_CERTIFICATE_TIMESTAMP=0 or MERKLE_LEAF_TYPE_TIMESTAMPED_ENTRY=0; both happen to be 0)
- u64 BE timestamp
- u16 BE entry_type
- (optional) 32 issuer_key_hash for precert_entry
- u24 BE length prefix + body
- u16 BE extensions length + extensions

The signed-input and merkle-tree-leaf forms differ ONLY in the second byte (signature_type vs leaf_type) — both currently encode as 0. The x509_entry and precert_entry forms differ only in entry_type and presence of issuer_key_hash.

Suggested rewrite: one builder taking (mode_byte: u8, entry: EntryKind, sct: &SCT, body: &[u8]) where EntryKind is X509 | Precert([u8;32]). The four current functions become thin wrappers. Eliminates ~100 lines of near-duplicate code; the byte-1-distinction test (verify.rs:1283-1291) becomes a single assertion on the mode parameter.

The existing test merkle_tree_leaf_second_byte_is_leaf_type_not_signature_type explicitly notes the convergence; the code structure currently hides it. A unified builder makes the relationship clear.
title: Duplicate signed_input + merkle_tree_leaf builders share most of their byte layout but live in 4 separate functions
